answer: The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short. Work waits on the grove until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zephyr of the next round. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
